decisions.finding: The complete yod contracts under its head, then forms a compact added low-left branch beside the continuing ordinary right tail. A white window corroborates the two-part anatomy but is not the sole criterion. Same-unit leelohav and BEL28 vayehi plain yods lack this branch; literal detached and joined pointed controls reproduce it. Append BC after the existing B5 without changing the literal name or expected spelling.

After a clear left-head contraction the complete yod expands into an added rounded lower-left lobe beside a continuing narrower right-tail descent. Literal joined pointed BEL28 vayomru and detached A247 vayatzigehu controls establish the added lobe; local and BEL28 plain yods end in ordinary narrow right tails without it. The diagnostic outer contour survives the ink contact. Append BC after the existing B8; no vowel change.

The complete yod beneath its existing holam has a head inset followed by an additional low-left branch alongside a farther-descending ordinary right tail. Same-font joined and detached pointed controls contrast with unbranched plain yods. The complete outer anatomy certifies BC without requiring a white aperture. Append BC after existing B9; retain the initial-vav vowel omission.
